artworks.title: Le Contrat
artworks.description: The image depicts two people in an elegantly furnished room. The man is seated on a chair behind a desk, his body shown from the waist up. He is holding a piece of paper in one hand and grasping the woman's hand with the other. The woman stands facing him, her body shown from head to hem, with her upper body slightly leaning forward. She has a smiling expression and her hair is styled in an elaborate updo. The man is dressed in a dark garment with a sash around his waist and a light shirt underneath. The desk is adorned with carvings, and on it rests a candlestick, paper, and a quill. In the background, there is a large upholstered bench with cushions, and clothes draped over one end. The walls have decorative paneling and framed art. The scene is softly lit.

artworks.title: La promenade des remparts de Paris
artworks.artist: Pierre-Francois Courtois after Augustin de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: The image shows a crowd gathered along a tree-lined promenade. The scene is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, with a straight-line horizon in the middle ground. Distant buildings and trees can be seen on the horizon. The artwork is an etching with detailed linework and shading, highlighting textures. The color palette includes gray and sepia tones, giving the scene an antique feel. Groups of people are engaged in conversation and activities, with a glass-fronted building on the right side. More people can be seen in the shadows further in the distance.

artworks.title: Tableau des portraits a la mode
artworks.artist: Pierre-Francois Courtois after Augustin de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: This drawing depicts an elegant gathering scene in an 18th-century setting. The artwork features finely dressed figures interacting and observing each other, with carriages nearby. The background includes townhouses and a monument. In the foreground, a small dog is seen running. The detailed artwork portrays the social norms, fashion, and lifestyle of the era.

artworks.title: Ballet at the Opera
artworks.artist: Pierre-François Basan after Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: This is a detailed engraving showing elegantly dressed figures engaged in a dance. The scene is possibly set in a woodland clearing, with trees forming a canopy above. The engraving showcases fine lines, cross-hatching, and a monochromatic color palette to create textures and movement. Figures in motion, a seated woman, musicians, and a distant landscape are also depicted in the scene.

artworks.title: The Tavern
artworks.artist: Pierre-François Basan after Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a garden scene. The image shows elegantly dressed individuals dancing and socializing outdoors. The setting includes lush foliage, architecture, and a house with classic European design features. The figures are joyful, engaging in dancing and socializing near a table. There is musical accompaniment in the background, creating a celebratory mood in the garden party setting.

artworks.title: The Happy Union
artworks.description: There is an image of two people sitting together in a lavishly detailed room. The man is seated on an armchair with one leg crossed over the other, while the woman is perched on the arm of the chair, leaning towards the man. Their bodies are depicted from head to knees. The man wears a tri-corner hat with a feather, a coat with intricate button detailing, waistcoat, breeches, and stockings. The woman has elaborate hair, and she wears a dress with ruffled sleeves and a decorative bodice, holding a small lyre-like musical instrument. The room has patterned wallpaper and a detailed carpet, a writing desk with a floral arrangement and a scroll, a wall sconce with candles, and a screen showing a domestic scene in the corner. An open book lies on the floor beside the chair.

artworks.title: Flore a son lever
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is seated, with her body angled to the left and her face turned towards the viewer. She has delicate facial features and a serene expression. Her hair is styled in an updo with flowers. She wears a flowing dress with off-the-shoulder sleeves, a bow at the chest, and voluminous draping fabric. She holds a bouquet of flowers in her hands. The background shows a cloudy sky, and the portrait is framed within a rectangular frame.

artworks.title: L'example des Meres
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a woman and a child, in an indoor setting. The woman is seated in a chair, engaged in sewing or embroidery, holding a piece of cloth. She has a gentle expression, soft features, neatly styled hair with floral decorations, and wears an ornate gown with lace. The young girl stands beside her, leaning on the chair, with a decorative cap, buttons on her dress, and patterned embellishments. A pull toy shaped like a sheep on wheels is next to the girl. The background includes paneled walls, a fireplace with a candlestick, and a side table with a coffee set. A small sleeping dog is on the floor near the table.

artworks.title: L'Amour à l'épreuve
artworks.description: The image shows two people in an opulent interior setting. Both individuals are seated on a lavish bed with a richly upholstered headboard, surrounded by luxurious drapery forming a canopy. The person on the left is sitting upright on a chair by the bed, while the person on the right reclines with their head nestled against the sitting individual's side. The seated individual has wavy hair and is dressed in what appears to be formal attire with elaborate cuffs. The reclining person also has styled hair, adorned with a decorative ribbon, and wears a flowing gown with a detailed bodice and sleeves. The room features intricate wall panels, large windows, a small table with a writing set, and a small dog curled up nearby.

artworks.title: L'amour frivole
artworks.description: This print shows a woman seated in a decorated room. She is in the center of the print, leaning back in her chair with her head and body angled to the right, her eyes closed. One of her feet rests on the ground, while another rests on a cushioned footrest on the right. She has pale skin and curly hair and wears a long dress with a very low neckline that partially reveals her breasts. On top of her hair is a large floral hat or headpiece, and there are more flowers on the bodice of her dress. A man leans in through an open window on the right, reaching towards the woman with a long, thin object, and appears to use it to hook a thin shawl that she has around her shoulders. He has pale skin and short, curled hair, and wears a formal jacket.  Next to the woman is a table with a mirror and a pin cushion and a few small boxes. In the bottom right corner is an open box revealing a hat with several feathers and ribbons, and on the left a piece of clothing has been draped over a chair. An open book lays on the ground next to the woman, as if she dropped it while dozing off. In the top left corner is tall set of drawers topped by a decorated clock, and on the wall above it is a round framed painting. Curtains line the paneled wall on the right next to the window.

artworks.title: Le Carquois épuisé (The Empty Quiver)
artworks.description: This print shows two people in a lavishly decorated room. On the left, a man is seated on an ornate sofa, leaning back comfortably with one arm on the backrest and one knee bent, his other leg extended. He wears a tailored outfit with a jacket and frilly cravat. He has light skin and light hair styled in curls around his ear. A discarded tricorn hat lies at his feet. He looks up at the woman standing next to him on the right. She wears a richly adorned dress with ruffles and lace, shoes with a small heel, a bracelet on her wrist, and ruffled collar around her neck. She also has light skin and light, curled hair, put in an updo on the top of her head. She holds a small makeup compact up to her face in one hand and a small brush in the other hand as she looks down at the man beside her. A small dog is near her feet, jumping up on its hind legs. The room features heavy draped curtains on the left and ornate furniture including a fireplace on the far right. To the right of the woman is a small folding screen decorated with an image of a man in a robe and a flat hat. In the center, above the woman, is a large statue of a cherub. It appears to aim a bow at the couple below, but the quiver by its side is empty. A large clock hangs on the wall above the cherub statue.

artworks.title: Le bain (The Bath)
artworks.artist: Nicolas François Regnault after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin

artworks.title: Le Lever
artworks.description: The image shows three women in a richly decorated interior setting. One woman is central, depicted nearly in full, standing and wrapping herself with a piece of fabric. She has delicate facial features, classic makeup, and elegantly styled hair. Accompanied by a small dog on a chair beside her, behind her, to the left, stands another woman in a red gown with a white cap. To the right, the third woman sits in profile facing a mirror on an ornate wall. She wears a green dress with pink bows and a lace-adorned cap. The room features a patterned carpet, a canopy bed with blue and gold trimmings.

artworks.title: Les cerises
artworks.description: The image displays three figures engaged in various activities. One male figure is on a ladder, reaching into a tree, possibly picking fruit or leaves. A second figure, a woman, stands near him gazing upward. A third figure, another woman, sits nearby, looking at the man and placing a hand on a dog beside her. In the background, a horse with a basket and some sheep can be seen. The scene is set outdoors, surrounded by trees, foliage, and hills in the distance. There are no visible jewelry items, but natural and rustic objects like a ladder and baskets are present. The setting is detailed and classical in style.

artworks.title: Le chemin de la fortune
artworks.artist: Nicolas Joseph Voyez after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
artworks.description: The image captures a group of people in a room. On the left, a woman in an elaborate dress stands next to another woman seated on the floor wearing a bonnet. Next to them, a man stands holding a violin. Two other seated figures are present; one holds a book and the other is older, sitting on a chair holding a smoking pipe. A small dog sits by the seated man. The room features a bust, heavy curtains, a chandelier, pillars, a large framed circular painting, and a cello on the floor. In the background, there is a large round painting or relief with a reclining figure.

artworks.title: Le couché de la mariée
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 47 x 33.9 cm (18 1/2 x 13 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a luxurious interior scene with an elaborate canopy bed. The drawing showcases an ornate room featuring intricate wall detailing with garlands and classical motifs. The centerpiece is a grand canopy bed with richly textured drapery and a surmounting feather crown. The decor includes a table holding a candelabra and a bowl of fruit. The ceiling is curved with ornamental cherubs and classical pillars. The drawing highlights the attention to detail in both structural and decorative elements typical of the Rococo style.

artworks.title: Le couché de la mariée
artworks.artist: Jean-Michel Moreau and Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
artworks.description: The image shows an interior setting with elegantly dressed women engaged in various activities. They are positioned around a large, ornate bed with an elaborate canopy. One woman is seated near a lit candlestick, while another rests her head on the bed's soft furnishings. The women have elaborate hairstyles and wear flowing, layered gowns with intricate details. The room features a high ceiling with embellished moldings, engraved panels, grand columns, and decorative carvings, creating a sense of grandeur.

artworks.title: Le curieux
artworks.description: This print depicts two women in an elaborately decorated room, with a man looking through the window of a door on the left. In the center, one of the women sits on a bench, facing the left. She is wearing a bonnet and a voluminous dress. Her skirts have been pushed up to expose her legs and buttocks, with her legs stretched out on the couch. On the left, the other woman stands next to her. This woman has a lace bonnet over her hair and wears a similar dress with ruffles and voluminous skirts. She holds a large needle or syringe and is bending down towards the woman on the couch. A small dog stands by her feet, its legs propped up on the couch. Behind the standing woman is a doorway on the left with a window on the top. A man is peeking into the room, pushing the curtain of the window aside. The room is adorned with ornate wall decorations and decorative furniture such as a table on the right and a large mirror, and the floor is covered in a patterned rug. The print is surrounded by a border of off-white paper.

artworks.title: Le danger du tete-a-tete
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman with visible upper bodies seated in an ornate interior setting. The woman is sitting on a chair, while the man is kneeling beside her, gesturing towards her. The woman has her hair styled in an elaborate updo and is wearing an elegant gown. The man is dressed in an 18th-century style suit. The setting is lavish with decorative elements such as drapery, a ceramic vase, and intricate furniture. The room is furnished with carved chairs, and a patterned carpet is seen on the floor. The decor reflects an aristocratic style.

artworks.title: L'enlevement nocturne
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene featuring a group of individuals in a wooded area. Two horse-drawn carriages are present, with riders and bystanders interacting. One figure is elevated among trees, appearing to be assisted or pulled down. The setting includes detailed trees and foliage, with an architectural element visible in the background.

artworks.title: L'Epouse indiscrete
artworks.description: The image shows a person reclining on a luxurious bed with elaborate fabric curtains. They have curly hair, detailed clothing, and are surrounded by opulent décor. The setting includes a plush bed, ornate canopy, richly decorated curtains, and intricate wood paneling. Another figure is partially visible sitting in a chair to the right, with similar styled hair and clothing.

artworks.title: Le fruit de l'amour secret
artworks.description: This print shows a lavishly decorated room with ornate furnishings. In the center is a large canopy with heavy, patterned curtains. Under it, a woman sits on what appears to be a cushioned chair. She wears a gown with a low neckline and a cloth covering wrapped over her head. To the left, two people in cloaks and hats stand in front of an open doorway, carrying a swaddled infant. One of the woman's hands grasps the cloth around the infant. Her head, however, is turned to the right, looking at a person who sits in a chair, their back to us. This person wears a long jacket and has tightly curled hair, and they have their left arm outstretched to hold the woman's other hand. Another person, perhaps a child, also stands in front of the woman, looking up at her. This person has their back to us as well, and they wear a long, flowing gown, and have their hair in an updo. On the right is a tall open window, and near the bottom left is a stack of pillows and blankets. The walls appear to be painted with intricate designs. Below the print is a border of off-white paper, featuring a crest at the bottom with a crown and shield.
